headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 14, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 26.73%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark's return of 14.57%. This results in an average alpha of 12.17%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 49.54%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', still shows a respectable return of 18.75%. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, reinforcing the strength of the portfolio's positioning. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
